title: Paid work outcome retrospective

description.need: An outside verdict on paid work, accepted, rejected, a duplicate, a score or silence, is the only feedback that measures the craft rather than the agent's opinion of it, and most of it is lost: the win is celebrated, the rejection is filed, the silence is never recorded at all, and the recipes that shaped the work stay exactly as they were. The opposite failure costs as much: a lesson written from one client's mood, or one that names the client, the account or a path, is charter memory dressed as craft, and it teaches every other adopter something false.
description.input: The outcome and when it arrived, the client's or the venue's own words, the work as delivered with its evidence, the recipes and versions that shaped it, and the lessons already recorded against those recipes.
description.core_action: Decide what the outcome actually says about the craft, separating what was about this client or venue from what would hold for anyone doing this kind of work, and attach each lesson that generalizes to the recipe whose judgment it tested, stripped of any account, client, credential or path.
description.output: For each recipe that shaped the work, either a proposed lesson in the lane format against the version used, general and free of identifying detail, or a recorded judgment that this outcome taught nothing general; and the specific detail kept as charter memory, where it belongs.

activities.label: Record the outcome, when it came and the client's or venue's own words
Trace which recipes and which versions shaped the work
Separate what was about this client from what would hold for anyone
Strip every account, client, credential and path from the general lessons
Propose each lesson on the recipe it tested and keep the rest as charter memory

outcomes.statement: Every verdict is recorded, the quiet ones as carefully as the loud ones.
success_criteria: Accepted, rejected, duplicate, scored and no response are all recorded, since silence after a proposal or a delivery is an outcome and usually the most common one.
The client's or venue's words are kept verbatim in charter memory before they are interpreted, so the interpretation can be checked against them later.
No response is recorded only after a waiting period the operator chose, so a slow reply is not mistaken for none.

outcomes.statement: What reaches a recipe would help a stranger, and everything else stays with the adoption.
success_criteria: A lesson reaches a recipe only if an agent in a different organization, doing this work for a different client on a different venue, would be better off knowing it.
No lesson names a client, account, credential, file path, person or venue; knowledge about one venue belongs in that recipe's examples, not in its lessons.
One outcome is evidence, not a rule: a lesson drawn from a single verdict says so, and a pattern is claimed only when it recurs independently.
A lesson is attached to the recipe whose judgment the outcome actually tested, at the version it used, rather than to every recipe that touched the work.

outcomes.statement: Success is explained, not merely counted.
success_criteria: An accepted outcome is examined for what made it acceptable, since a success nobody explains teaches nothing and may have been luck.
Where an outcome contradicts a recipe's guidance, the lesson says so plainly and proposes the change rather than softening it, and a person decides whether it lands.

guidance: Record every outcome, silence included; it is the most common verdict and the one that goes unwritten. Keep the client's own words before interpreting them. Ask of each lesson whether a stranger doing this work elsewhere would be better off knowing it; if not, it is charter memory. Strip every client, account, credential and path. One verdict is evidence, not a rule. Explain wins as carefully as losses, and attach each lesson to the recipe it actually tested.
use_cases: An operator whose agents have delivered dozens of paid jobs and proposals, and who cannot say which parts of the method are winning work and which are costing it.
A specialist whose proposals keep meeting silence, where no single case says anything but the record across many of them might.
A competitor whose final ranking fell far from the visible estimate, who needs to know whether the validation or the modelling was at fault before the next entry.
A registry maintainer receiving lessons from many adopters, who needs them to arrive general and scrubbed rather than as one operator's client notes.
An operator whose rejected delivery came back with a detailed complaint, where the useful part is buried in context that must never be published.

recommended_trigger.rationale: An outcome arrives when the client or venue decides, and the lesson is best written while the work and the words are fresh. Silence is the one verdict that announces nothing, so adoption turns the end of a waiting period into its event; it is still an outcome arriving, not a scheduled sweep.

personalization_needs: How long silence must last before it counts as no response, for each kind of engagement, because a proposal and a delivered job are answered on very different clocks.
Which recipes each specialist has adopted and at which versions, because a lesson attaches to the version the work used.
Where charter memory lives for this operator, so specific detail has somewhere to go instead of leaking into a general lesson.
Who reviews proposed lessons before they reach the registry, since promotion is by proposal and a person adopts it.

input_schema.name: independent_outcomes_for_a_pattern
input_schema.description: How many independent outcomes must point the same way before a lesson is proposed as a pattern rather than as a single observation. Outcomes from the same client or the same week are not independent, and counting them as such makes the number about the client.

provenance.source_note: Authored 2026-09-24 as the feedback loop for specialist agents that adopt recipes and take paid work under a human account: every real outcome appends a lesson to the recipes that shaped it. The counting of independent recurrences and the rule that a person decides on the change come from the lesson promotion recipe named in from_recipes. The test for what generalizes, and the rule that a lesson naming a credential, account, path or person is charter memory, are this lane's own contract.
